gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the hubs that turn solar battery cameras into one centrally recorded system do not take 4G cameras: Reolink's Home Hub holds 8 cameras and 'not compatible with … 4G cameras', eufy's HomeBase 3 marks its 4G Starlight Cam S230 'Not Compatible' and stores 4G LTE Cam S330 footage 'only under Wi-Fi mode', and Reolink battery 4G cameras cannot join a Reolink NVR either.
standout_why: ChatGPT ran no searches and got no result pages in either saved chat, so there were no rival pages to compare against. Its own answer lists '4G LTE solar camera' and 'Multi-camera solar system with centralized monitoring or storage' as separate options and asks the shopper to pick Wi-Fi or 4G and a camera count. It never says that the two options exclude each other for Reolink and eufy hubs, and it gives no camera limit for a hub.
decides: If the shopper picks 'No Wi-Fi (4G LTE needed)' and '2–4' or '5+' cameras, a Reolink Home Hub or eufy HomeBase 3 system won't work. Each 4G camera, such as the Arenti GO3G or AnywhereCam Eagle 4G Pro, stays a standalone camera with its own SIM and app. If the shopper has Wi-Fi and wants several cameras, the pick holds: Reolink Argus 4 Pro plus Solar Panel 2 on a Home Hub (factory-supported, 8 cameras at most), or eufy SoloCam S340 on HomeBase 3 (storage and BionicMind compatible). Separately, every Reolink panel lists a 0–45 °C charging temperature and its 4 m lead should not be extended past 9 m. That limits where you can mount the panel and how much winter charging to expect.

findings.label: Camera limit and excluded camera types
findings.value: Up to 8 cameras of any type. Not compatible with 2MP battery cameras or 4G cameras. Cameras must be on the same LAN as the hub. A camera can be added to only one Home Hub or NVR.
findings.source_title: Reolink Home Hub with Argus 4 Pro (Argus 4 Pro Kit)
findings.note: Taken from the kit page's compatibility notes. The page showed no price.

findings.product: Reolink Home Hub / Home Hub Pro
findings.label: Hub compatibility table
findings.value: Home Hub: 'total number of connected cameras cannot exceed 8, regardless of camera type'. Home Hub Pro: 12 in total on hardware BASE_WENNT3NA512C/BASE_WUNNT3NA512C. On BASE_WUNNT3NA5/BASE_WENNT3NA5, up to 24 battery cameras and up to 12 PoE/Wi-Fi cameras at default bitrates. '4G cameras are Not Supported.'
findings.note: The page shows no update date.

findings.label: Home Hub support status
findings.value: Argus 4 Series (incl. Argus 4 Pro, B740): factory-supported, no firmware upgrade needed

findings.label: Home Hub support status
findings.value: Hardware BIPC_560MIX16M35B238MP: 'Released, upgradable'. Update to the latest firmware before adding it to the hub.
findings.note: Older Argus Eco hardware BIPC_36S3216MGUN is listed as 'Not currently supported'.

findings.label: Box contents and ports
findings.value: 2× Argus 4 Pro, 2× Reolink Solar Panel 2 (6 W), 1× Home Hub, USB-C cables. The camera charges over USB-C, has a 5,000 mAh battery and 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi. The hub takes 12 V/1 A DC and holds up to 2× 1 TB microSD.
findings.source_title: Reolink Home Hub with Argus 4 Pro
findings.note: The page also says 128 GB max per camera.

findings.product: Reolink Solar Panel / Solar Panel 2 / Solar Panel 3
findings.label: Output, connector and charging temperature
findings.value: 3 W: 6 V 0.54 A, micro-USB or USB-C. Solar Panel 2: 6 W, 6 V 0.97 A, USB-C. Solar Panel 3: 12 W, 6.4 V 1.9 A, USB-C. All have a 4 m cable, are IP65 and list a charging temperature of 0 °C to +45 °C (32–113 °F).
findings.source_title: Getting Started with Reolink Solar Panel
findings.note: If the camera and panel ports don't match, use a USB-C to micro-USB cable. DC-powered Reolink cameras are not compatible.

findings.label: Extension cable limit
findings.value: Up to 2 extension cables, 13 m (42 ft) total. Above 9 m (30 ft) is not recommended because of power loss and slower or unstable charging. Other brands' extension cables are not recommended.
findings.source_title: How Many Extension Cables Can I Use with a Single Reolink Solar Panel

findings.label: Camera–panel compatibility and exclusions
findings.value: All Reolink rechargeable battery cameras with a matching charging port work with Reolink solar panels. The original Argus, Keen and Doorbell (Battery) are excluded, and PoE and DC-powered cameras are not compatible. Argus 4 Pro (B740X) and Argus Eco Ultra (B360) are listed under Solar Panel (3W). The other battery cameras can use Solar Panel 2 (6 W).
findings.source_title: Which Cameras Can Work with Reolink Solar Panel
findings.note: The page's headings were partly missing when read, so I took the grouping from the text order. Reolink's own Argus 4 Pro kit ships with Solar Panel 2 (6 W). The page also says a higher-wattage panel than the recommended one may be used.

findings.label: NVR pairing limits
findings.value: Depends on the camera and NVR models and versions. 'Battery-powered 4G cameras do not support use with NVRs.' Once a battery Wi-Fi camera is added to an NVR, you can no longer use it on its own in the app or client, and getting that back takes a hard reset.
findings.source_title: Can I Add Reolink Battery-powered Cameras to Reolink NVR
findings.note: The page's compatibility table didn't render, so there are no per-model rows.

findings.label: Solar/battery and 4G camera compatibility
findings.value: SoloCam S340 (T8170), SoloCam S220 (T8134), SoloCam E40 (T8131), eufyCam S3 Pro (T8162), eufyCam 3 (T8160), eufyCam 3C (T8161) and SoloCam E30 (T8171): storage and BionicMind both Compatible. 4G LTE Cam S330 (T86P2): storage 'Only under Wi-Fi mode'. 4G Starlight Cam S230 (T8150): Not Compatible ('operates via cellular signal and does not connect to Wi-Fi').
findings.note: The page states no maximum camera count and no firmware requirement.
